gold.user: Developer A wants to compare the dependency graph between the main branch and the feature branch of the Hello-World repository to see what changes have been made in dependencies.
gold.ideal: The response should provide a detailed comparison of the dependencies between the two branches, highlighting any additions, removals, or updates.

gold.user: Security Analyst B needs to export the Software Bill of Materials (SBOM) for the Hello-World repository to assess its dependencies for compliance and security vulnerabilities.
gold.ideal: The response should return a structured SBOM in a standard format (like SPDX or CycloneDX) that lists all dependencies used in the repository along with their versions.

gold.user: DevOps Engineer C is looking to create a snapshot of the current dependency graph for the Hello-World repository to ensure they have a record of the dependencies at this point in time before making major changes.
gold.ideal: The response should confirm the creation of the snapshot and provide details such as the snapshot ID and timestamp.
